name: subscribe
description: Ask the mod to read a set of device values every interval_s game seconds and push an update event when a value other than the clock changed (topic devices, the default), or to be told when a world finishes loading and when the game state changes (topic world, no other params). items, include and gateway_id are read_devices'; one subscription holds what one read_devices call may (128 items, 1,024 values). The reply carries the subscription id and the first reading in read_devices' reply shape. A subscription over a limit is refused with subscription_limit: poll with read_devices at the same interval instead. Subscriptions end with the connection, on unsubscribe, or with a subscription_ended event (world_changed, revoked, limit, read_failed).

topic.description: devices (the default): device reads; world: world_changed and game_state events.

interval_s.description: Game seconds between reads; default 1. A paused game reads nothing.
